sourceChecks.text: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1CH2:24はヘズロンの妻Abijahと、アシュフルの誕生を記す。
